category_title: Underachieving students in difficult PE contexts who alternate between task involvement and ephemeral off-task behaviors
scenario_title: Managing ephemeral off-task behaviors during gymnastics workshops
minimal_context: The student is at a gymnastics workshop station in a PE class, using an instruction card to practice somersaults and jumps with a small group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the instruction cards at this station and start practicing your somersaults and jumps. Make sure to manage your repetitions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Here, I arrive at the activity, quickly read the sheet to go through the various exercises. Here, I want to check if the exercises are hard. (Executes them one by one, slowly and precisely)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep practicing the exercises on the sheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well, I try my best and then I practice this somersault, the hardest! (Makes a correct jump, puts up the equipment, and waits idly)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for your next repetition.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Chats with friends, gives a kick to a mat, and begins wandering about the gym) I work a bit but in the end it's boring to do the same thing over and over again, so I have a laugh with my mates. It's no big deal, and after that I work as well.
